title: Finland: 27.0 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €991,500 a year
markdown:
# Finland: 27.0 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €991,500 a year

> Closes 27.0 of 65.5 missing patients a year (41%) · €991,500 of €1M · €8,500 left: less than the next measure costs

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in Finland, 27 get treatment that aims to cure. By county it runs from 18 in Lapland to 36 in Vantaa and Kerava. Bringing every county below the national share up to it is about 66 patients a year; 50 of them are in the 7 counties that are below it by more than chance. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties, where 30.4 of 100 are treated to cure, about 123.1 patients a year are missing. [^care_curative][^model]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 27.0% to 27.9% by 2028: 27.0 more patients a year (range 0.0–42.3), for €991,500 a year, about €36,790 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model] That closes 41% of the measured shortfall against Finland as a whole (65.5 patients a year). [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | County | Funded measures | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Lapland** | Thoracic surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Video MDT review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital; Stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Travel and accommodation support for patients far from the university hospital; Audit of treatment records ("no treatment on record") | €174,000 | 4.9 |
| 2 | **Kymenlaakso** | Thoracic surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Video MDT review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital; Stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated | €117,640 | 3.4 |
| 3 | **Satakunta** | Thoracic surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Video MDT review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital | €121,280 | 3.3 |
| 4 | **North Karelia** | Thoracic surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Video MDT review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital; Stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated | €114,400 | 2.8 |
| 5 | **Southwest Finland** | Stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Audit of treatment records ("no treatment on record") | €67,480 | 2.3 |
| 6 | **Kanta-Häme** | Thoracic surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated | €64,840 | 2.2 |
| 7 | **South Karelia** | Video MDT review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital; Travel and accommodation support for patients far from the university hospital; Stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Audit of treatment records ("no treatment on record") | €97,500 | 2.0 |
| 8 | **South Savo** | Thoracic surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated | €60,920 | 1.8 |
| 9 | **North Ostrobothnia** | Stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated | €44,000 | 1.7 |
| 10 | **Kainuu** | Thoracic surgeon reviews every decision not to operate; Stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Travel and accommodation support for patients far from the university hospital | €66,600 | 1.1 |
| 11 | **North Savo** | Stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated | €27,640 | 1.0 |
| 12 | **Central Ostrobothnia** | Stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated; Travel and accommodation support for patients far from the university hospital; Fitness assessment and prehabilitation before deciding against curative treatment | €27,200 | 0.5 |
| 13 | **Vantaa and Kerava** | Audit of treatment records ("no treatment on record") | €8,000 | 0.0 |
| | **Total** | | **€991,500** | **27.0 (0.0–42.3)** |

Each county's own plan lists the owner, the first step and the measure for every action. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €17,418,643 a year; modelled to avoid 29.9 deaths a year (6.8–77.9). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 27.0% (2019–2023, measured) → 27.9% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

€8,500 of the €1M is left. [^model] That is less than the cheapest measure that would still add something, fitness assessment and prehabilitation in Kainuu, at EUR 13,300 a year. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 2,303 deaths a year in Finland, and this plan is modelled to avoid 4.0 of them (range 0.0-12.7). [^deaths][^model]

## Limits

- No trial has measured these effects, so they are assumptions. Each range runs from all assumptions at their lowest to all at their highest. It is not a probability. [^model]
- County shares are not adjusted for stage at diagnosis, fitness and other illness, histology, how the cancer was found, or smoking. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- A check found that none of 3 measured outcomes matched the estimated symptom-to-treatment clock beyond chance. [^model]
